newsitem.title: FRANCE: French business leaders unhappy with Juppe - poll.
newsitem.headline: French business leaders unhappy with Juppe - poll.

text.p: Two out of three French business leaders are unhappy with Prime Minister Alain Juppe, fearing he will cause social unrest during a time of economic weakness, according to a public opinion poll made public on Tuesday.
The Louis Harris survey for the financial daily Les Echos found that just 28 percent of business leaders viewed the Juppe government in a positive light.
Fully three-quarters of the leaders saw the economic situation going downhill, the pollsters found. About half held that view in a similar poll conducted one year ago.

The vast majority of leaders gave Juppe credit for helping bring down interest rates and keeping France on track towards greater European unity. He was blamed for not doing enough to simplify business regulations or cut unemployment.
The survey relied on interviews conducted in late October with 401 individuals heading a business with at least 10 employees.
